before.shape: Workspace { id, name, purpose, items: string[] }
before.problem: every observation's TEXT was pushed into one global array per workspace, with no owner, conversation, session or source; `state()` returned those arrays to every consumer
reachable_by: any caller reading the state object

after.shape: Workspace { id, name, purpose, createdAt, observations: [{ id, text, origin }] }

origin.scope: conversation-local | session-local | user-persistent | project-associated | agent-reported | historical | inferred
origin.memoryId: optional link so deleting the memory deletes the observation

classification.conversation-local: readable only in the conversation that filed it
classification.session-local: readable only in the same runtime session
classification.user-persistent: readable, never attributed to another conversation unless labelled
classification.agent-reported: readable in the run's conversation only
classification.inferred: readable in the conversation that inferred it; never presented as fact

access.WorkspaceManager.all(): names, purpose and counts only — never text
access.CognitiveCore.state(conversationId): workspaces as summaries; no observation text

findings.finding: Observation text was global and unattributed.
Reasoning and plan text was filed with no scope at all, so it was available to every conversation.
findings.policy: filed as session-local and never injected into another conversation

findings.finding: A legacy observation with no origin could be claimed by any conversation.
findings.policy: unattributed observations are retained for the workspace display and never shown as a conversation's context

findings.finding: Workspace names could leak content if a name carried it.
findings.policy: default workspace names are fixed; a user-created title is not observation content

lifecycle.delete_memory: observations carrying that memoryId are removed (WorkspaceManager.forgetMemory)
lifecycle.delete_conversation: observations filed in it are removed (WorkspaceManager.forgetConversation)
lifecycle.retention: session-scope observations do not survive their session; durable ones survive conversation deletion, as memory does
